name: ISS $OEM Source Node
description: Single-source flow node (SDN OD-Flow Phase 1b; typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only): a TimerTick (TICK) on 'tick' makes it emit the ISS operator ephemeris as one SDS $OEM FlatBuffer on the 'oem' output port. The $OEM is built in-module from the checked-in NASA ISS OEM fixture (EME2000, TIME_SYSTEM UTC, CENTER Earth) via the inverse of analysis/od's oem_fb_reader - the SAME state series the RMS-parity gate uses. It STORES NOTHING: ephemeris exists only as the emitted frame, held in memory for the duration of the OD fit downstream. No capabilities.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The flow trigger firing (TimerTick, TICK); its fields are not read.

inputPorts.description: The TimerTick (TICK) that drives one $OEM emission.

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $OEM ephemeris (FlatBuffer). Consumed in-memory by analysis/od.fit; never stored.

methods.description: Builds the ISS $OEM FlatBuffer from the embedded fixture and emits it on a timer tick.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The flow trigger firing (TimerTick, TICK); its fields are not read.

inputPorts.description: The TimerTick (TICK) that drives one $OEM emission.

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $OEM ephemeris (compact form: EPHEMERIS_DATA + START_TIME + STEP_SIZE). Consumed in-memory by analysis/od.fit; never stored.

methods.description: Builds the ISS $OEM in the COMPACT form (flat EPHEMERIS_DATA + START_TIME + STEP_SIZE) that uniform-cadence providers carry, and emits it on a timer tick.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns one TimerTick into the one $OEM it emits, built from the checked-in ephemeris on the calling thread; no thread is created.
